# DinePulse — Enterprise Cafe & Restaurant CRM SaaS System

> DinePulse is an enterprise multi-tenant Customer Relationship Management SaaS platform architected for cafes, dining restaurants, food chains, and multi-branch hospitality groups.

## Portal Architecture
- **Super Admin Portal** (`/super-admin/login`, `/super-admin/dashboard`): Platform-wide command center for managing tenant restaurant organizations, plan quotas, global audit trails, and platform telemetry.
- **Restaurant Admin Portal** (`/admin/login`, `/admin/dashboard`): Operational headquarters for managing restaurant outlets, floor plans, real-time table statuses, reservation schedules, customer 360° profiles, POS orders, menu categories, loyalty programs, and financial analytics.
- **Staff Portal** (`/staff/login`, `/staff/dashboard`): High-speed, mobile-responsive touch terminal for floor managers, servers, and hosts for rapid customer registration, table seating, active order status tracking, and assigned shift tasks.

## Security & Tenancy
- **Database**: PostgreSQL on Supabase with strict tenant boundary enforcement (`organization_id` & `branch_id`).
- **Access Control**: Granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) enforced across API middleware, frontend route guards, and Row Level Security (RLS) policies.
- **Authentication**: JWT verification with hardened session rotation and audit logging.

## Public Endpoints
- Portal Gateway: https://dinepulsecrm.com/
- Super Admin Login: https://dinepulsecrm.com/super-admin/login
- Restaurant Admin Login: https://dinepulsecrm.com/admin/login
- Staff Portal Login: https://dinepulsecrm.com/staff/login
- Health API: https://dinepulsecrm.com/api/v1/health
